content.tagline: Korean skincare built on rice bran water and temple-kimchi probiotics
content.descriptor: ABELTY (UNIC Cosmetic, Anyang-si, Gyeonggi-do) — 4 SKUs: a rice-bran-water double serum and sun serum, a rice-powder cleansing foam, and a cream with traditional temple-kimchi probiotics
about: ABELTY is a skincare brand by the Korean company UNIC Cosmetic (유니씨코스메틱, Anyang-si, Gyeonggi-do). According to the brand, the name is inspired by the Latin word "abel", meaning vitality; the slogan is "All Beauty Lies in Vitality — From the Korean Table to Your Skin". The brand's story: rice, kimchi and seasoned greens on the Korean table are more than food — they are a time-honored ritual that restores balance, which ABELTY carries into skincare.
Per the brand's own product roadmap, the 2025 rice line is to be followed by a kimchi line in 2026 and a third line in 2027 — these are the brand's stated plans, not yet released products.

Three products in the Rice line and one in the K-Probiotics line are listed in the brand's current export price list: a rice-bran-water double serum and sun serum, a rice-powder cleansing foam, and a cream with traditional temple-kimchi probiotics. Made in Korea.

lines.name: Rice line
lines.note: Two serums and a cleansing foam built on rice bran water and rice powder: a two-layer glow serum (77% essence + 23% cream), an SPF50+ PA++++ sun serum with niacinamide for dark spots, and a cleansing foam with 0.7% Korean rice powder.

lines.name: K-Probiotics Soothing Relief Cream
lines.note: A cream with Weissella cibaria probiotics from temple kimchi handcrafted by Venerable Jigyeon, a master of Korean temple cuisine (per the brand), and a patented plant extract (Korea Patent No. 10-2669645, per the brand) — for sensitive skin.

catalog_notes: Applied as the first step of a routine after cleansing: a two-layer rice-bran-water serum (77% essence + 23% cream) for glow and even tone; per the brand, it has completed hypoallergenic testing and testing for dark-spot reduction.

Applied as the last step each morning: an SPF50+ PA++++ sun serum with rice bran water and niacinamide, with a lightweight no-white-cast texture; per the brand, it has completed hypoallergenic testing and testing for dark-spot reduction. Listed in the brand's export price list.
Used morning and evening to cleanse the face: a foam with 0.7% rice powder and hyaluronic acid — gentle cleansing without a tight after-feel.
Applied as a daily moisturizer for sensitive or reactive skin: a cream with Weissella cibaria probiotics from temple kimchi and a patented plant extract — barrier support and soothing.
